title: [AUG-15] Add search and status filter to session list
why_we_need_this: The session list is a flat, unfiltered list. A manager doing 5 meetings/week accumulates 20+ sessions/month. Finding a specific session is scroll-only, and filtering by status (completed, failed) is not possible.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Search input below the sidebar header filters sessions by title (case-insensitive, as-you-type)
- [ ] Status filter chips or dropdown allows filtering by one or more statuses (uploading, transcribing, completed, failed)
- [ ] Filters persist within the session (cleared on page reload is fine)
- [ ] Empty filter results show "No sessions match your search" message
- [ ] Search input and filter controls use existing design tokens and sidebar color scheme
